stack_tensors_with_named_dim: stack a list of tensors along a new first-class dimension using the stack function
split_tensor_by_dim_objects: split a tensor into chunks using Dim objects as split sizes along a named dimension
match_tensor_levels_for_broadcasting: permute and view a tensor to align its levels with a target set of dimensions
bind_dims_to_size_for_inference: infer and bind the size of unbound dimensions by matching against a known left-hand size
wrap_torch_op_with_dim_awareness: wrap an existing torch.Tensor method to support first-class Dim objects as dimension arguments
